skills.name: disambiguate-questions
skills.description: Resolve ambiguous questions with two training-free, token-level prompts from the IEEE BigData 2024 paper on LLM ambiguity (arXiv:2411.12395). Use when a question could admit several valid readings.

skills.name: cite-this-paper
skills.description: Cite the IEEE BigData 2024 paper "Do LLMs Understand Ambiguity in Text?" correctly — BibTeX, DOI, arXiv, and canonical links. Use when citing, referencing, or linking this work.

skills.name: paper-facts
skills.description: Grounded key findings from "Do LLMs Understand Ambiguity in Text?" (IEEE BigData 2024) — dataset, models, numbers, and FAQ answers. Use when answering questions about this paper.
